tools.name: run_deploy_script_and_notify
tools.description: Runs a deployment script for the given environment in the build workspace and posts the outcome to a Slack webhook. Use it to trigger a release step and tell the team the result.

params.name: environment
params.description: Target environment name such as staging or production

params.name: script_path
params.description: Path to the deploy script in the workspace

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Slack incoming webhook URL for the notification

tools.code:
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def run_deploy_script_and_notify(environment: str, script_path: str, webhook_url: str) -> str:
    script = Path(script_path)
    if not script.is_file():
        return f"Script not found: {script_path}"

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
        log_file = Path(scratch) / "deploy.log"
        with open(log_file, "w+") as log:
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ["bash", str(script)],
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                env={"DEPLOY_ENV": environment, "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/bin"},
                timeout=1800,
            )
            log.seek(0)
            tail = "".join(log.readlines()[-15:])

    status = "succeeded" if proc.returncode == 0 else "failed"
    payload = {
        "text": f"Deploy to {environment} {status} (exit {proc.returncode})\n```{tail}```"
    }
    with requests.Session() as session:
        resp = session.post(webhook_url, json=payload, timeout=15)

    return (
        f"Deploy {status} with exit code {proc.returncode}. "
        f"Slack responded {resp.status_code}."
    )

tools.name: archive_build_artifacts
tools.description: Reads the artifact files from a build's output directory that match a pattern and moves them into the archive directory for that build. Returns the list of moved files and their sizes.

params.name: build_id
params.description: Identifier of the build whose artifacts are archived

params.name: archive_root
params.description: Root directory of the artifact archive

params.name: pattern
params.description: Glob pattern of files to archive

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-artifacts")


@mcp.tool()
def archive_build_artifacts(build_id: str, source_dir: str, archive_root: str, pattern: str = "*") -> dict:
    src = Path(source_dir)
    result = {"build_id": build_id, "moved": [], "total_bytes": 0, "errors": []}

    if not src.is_dir():
        result["errors"].append(f"Source directory missing: {source_dir}")
        return result

    dest = Path(archive_root) / build_id
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result["destination"] = str(dest)

    for item in sorted(src.glob(pattern)):
        if not item.is_file():
            continue
        size = item.stat().st_size
        try:
            target = shutil.move(str(item), str(dest / item.name))
        except OSError as exc:
            result["errors"].append(f"{item.name}: {exc}")
            continue
        result["moved"].append({"name": item.name, "size": size, "path": target})
        result["total_bytes"] += size

    result["count"] = len(result["moved"])
    return result

tools.name: terminate_cloud_runner
tools.description: Terminates a self-hosted EC2 CI runner instance, which permanently deletes it and ends the compute charges it was incurring.

params.name: instance_id
params.description: EC2 instance ID of the runner

tools.code:
import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ci-runners")


@mcp.tool()
def terminate_cloud_runner(instance_id: str) -> str:
    c = boto3.client("ec2")
    r = c.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
    s = r["TerminatingInstances"][0]
    return f"{instance_id}: {s['PreviousState']['Name']} -> {s['CurrentState']['Name']}"

tools.name: purchase_extra_build_minutes
tools.description: Looks up the current CI plan usage and then buys an additional pack of build minutes, charging the saved payment method. Returns the usage before the purchase and the receipt.

params.name: minutes_to_buy
params.description: Number of build minutes to purchase

params.name: max_price_cents
params.description: Maximum total price in cents allowed for the purchase

tools.code:
import os

import requests

BILLING_API_BASE = os.environ.get("CI_BILLING_API", "https://billing.ci.internal/v1")
BILLING_API_TOKEN = os.environ.get("CI_BILLING_TOKEN", "")


def purchase_extra_build_minutes(organization_id: str, minutes_to_buy: int, max_price_cents: int) -> dict:
    request_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {BILLING_API_TOKEN}"}

    usage_response = requests.get(
        f"{BILLING_API_BASE}/organizations/{organization_id}/usage",
        headers=request_headers,
        timeout=20,
    )
    usage_response.raise_for_status()
    current_usage_summary = usage_response.json()

    quote_response = requests.get(
        f"{BILLING_API_BASE}/pricing/minutes",
        params={"quantity": minutes_to_buy},
        headers=request_headers,
        timeout=20,
    )
    quote_response.raise_for_status()
    quoted_total_price_cents = quote_response.json()["total_cents"]

    if quoted_total_price_cents > max_price_cents:
        return {
            "purchased": False,
            "reason": "quoted price exceeds maximum",
            "quoted_cents": quoted_total_price_cents,
            "usage_before": current_usage_summary,
        }

    purchase_response = requests.post(
        f"{BILLING_API_BASE}/organizations/{organization_id}/minute-packs",
        json={"minutes": minutes_to_buy, "expected_total_cents": quoted_total_price_cents},
        headers=request_headers,
        timeout=30,
    )
    purchase_response.raise_for_status()
    purchase_receipt = purchase_response.json()

    return {
        "purchased": True,
        "charged_cents": quoted_total_price_cents,
        "usage_before": current_usage_summary,
        "receipt": purchase_receipt,
    }
